title: Mosul Dam turbine proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: So, this was another proof of concept where they scanned the Mosul Dam.

plain: Around 2024, a scanning method later pointed at the pyramids of Egypt was first tested on the Mosul Dam in Iraq, as a proof of concept to see whether it could pick out structures like the dam's turbines. The researcher Jeffrey Drum says this on the show, crediting the work to the researcher Filippo Biondi: "this was another proof of concept where they scanned the Mosul Dam." The point is that a method that works on a known structure would lend weight to what the same scans claim to find beneath the pyramids.
